name: Baserow
description: Read Baserow tables, fields, and rows from Baserow Cloud or a self-hosted instance. 4 generic read-only tools using database-token authentication.
instructions:
This connector uses Baserow's database API and is read-only.

**Setup**:
1. In Baserow, open Settings > Database tokens and create a token with read access only to the databases and tables this connector needs.
2. Set `BASEROW_API_TOKEN` to that token.
3. Set `BASEROW_URL` to the root Baserow API host, with no trailing slash. For Baserow Cloud use `https://api.baserow.io`. For self-hosted Baserow use your own host, for example `https://baserow.example.com`.

**Authentication**: Baserow database tokens use `Authorization: Token <token>`, not Bearer authentication. This adapter sends the header correctly. Database tokens only work with the database API; some account/workspace endpoints require JWT authentication and are intentionally not exposed here.

**Discovery order**: call `baserow_list_tables` first, then `baserow_list_fields` for the table you want to query. Every Baserow installation has different tables, so the adapter stays generic rather than creating one tool per table.

**Rows**: row tools always send `user_field_names=true`, so responses use human-readable field names instead of keys such as `field_1234`. `baserow_list_rows` supports search plus page/size pagination. Start with page 1 and a modest size; increase only when the task needs more rows.

**Self-hosted instances**: if the Baserow host is private or resolves to private address space, self-host AnythingMCP on the same network and allow the host through `SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS`; otherwise the outbound guard may block the request.

**Out of scope**: creating, updating, or deleting rows, fields, tables, databases, or workspace/account objects.

tools.name: baserow_list_tables
tools.description: List every table visible to the configured database token. Call this first to discover table IDs and names, for example table id 42 named Tasks.

tools.name: baserow_list_fields
tools.description: List the fields in one Baserow table so later row queries can use the real human-readable field names and understand their types.

table_id.description: Numeric table ID returned by baserow_list_tables, for example 42.

tools.name: baserow_list_rows
tools.description: List rows from one Baserow table using human-readable field names. Supports free-text search and page/size pagination; use baserow_list_fields first when the schema is unknown.

table_id.description: Numeric table ID returned by baserow_list_tables, for example 42.

search.description: Optional free-text search across searchable fields, for example overdue.

size.description: Number of rows per page. Use a modest page size such as 20 unless more rows are required.

tools.name: baserow_get_row
tools.description: Get one row by numeric row ID from a Baserow table, returning human-readable field names. Use baserow_list_rows to discover row IDs.

table_id.description: Numeric table ID returned by baserow_list_tables, for example 42.

row_id.description: Numeric row ID to retrieve, for example 123.
